size_allocation: Exact80/20 total neurons, balanced within E and I; integer remainders distributed in index order.
edge_allocation: Floor source_count*target_count*1000/N, then largest remainders with index tie-break; exact N*1000 connections.

pilot.required: IndependentRust reference spikes/states/traces/events, complete host/rank coverage, all resource exits zero.

construction: Existing target-owner-local stable counting path; no per-projection graph-construction MPI collective.
scientific_scope: Synthetic capacity test, neuron-count percentage only; no anatomical human-brain/NEST equivalence or scaling-curve claim.
